title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics auto-suggestions and runbook linking
author: Evelyn Park
description:
Motivation: Reduce on-call triage time by surfacing automated diagnostics and matching runbooks/quick-links in the incident-bot oncall flow. This PR implements an autosuggestion pipeline that scores diagnostic hits (metrics, recent errors, traces) and ranks candidate runbooks. It also adds a lightweight runbook linking UI component and an opt-in feature flag.

Summary of changes: - New suggestions service (internal/oncall/suggestions.go) that aggregates rule-based heuristics + simple ML score, with configurable confidence thresholds. - Runbook matcher (pkg/runbooks/matcher.go) that improves fuzzy-title matching and adds metadata filters (severity, team). - API additions: /v1/oncall/suggestions endpoint and webhook consumer for SLO/alert events. - Web UI: RunbookLinker component and CTA to attach best-match runbooks during triage. - Telemetry: metrics and event traces for suggestion latency, suggestion_accepted, suggestion_rejected. - Feature flag: INCIDENT_BOT_AUTOSUGGEST (off by default) and rollout plan.

Checklist: - [x] Core service implementation and unit tests - [x] Integration tests exercising API + web UI - [x] Basic e2e test in CI - [x] Docs: docs/oncall/diagnostics.md and runbook linking guide - [x] Feature-flagged rollout and safe defaults - [x] Added non-regression tests for existing oncall flows

Rollout plan: 1) Deploy behind feature flag to staging and enable for SRE group. 2) Monitor suggestion precision/recall metrics and suggestion_accepted rate for 48h. 3) Gradual enablement for 10% of prod oncall rotations, then full enablement if metrics stable.

Related tasks: ENG-4123 (improve runbook matching), SRE-87 (oncall triage time reduction), SUP-2211 (customer report of missing runbook links).
